title: 第21章 美人入怀片刻温馨第22章 你也是来溜达的
slug: 反派不朽帝族族人竟都是老六
content_zh:
………………
呼——
看了好一会后。
上官明月缓慢将《天音九玄》合上，眼眸透露着欣喜之色。
随后。
上官明月将目光投向了江尘。
柔声道：“谢谢你，我很喜欢！”
话音落下。
她将秘籍郑重的收了起来
……
时间飞逝。
两人一边喝茶一边聊天。
不知不觉间，天边出现了一抹亮光。
看着东方缓缓升起的太阳。
江尘转头看向了上官明月。
“这么着急要走，就不能在这里多留一段时间吗？”
上官明月缓慢摇了摇头。
开口回应：“已经不能再拖下去了，原本他们三天前就想让我回去的……”
说到这里时。
上官明月缓缓地下头，口中声音也变得微弱了几分，并没有再继续说下去。

江尘轻轻点了点头，并没有开口，而是缓缓伸出手臂，搂住了上官明月的肩膀。
上官明月身体微微一斜，将自己的头颅靠在了江尘的肩膀上。
此时。
两人都没有说话。
目光注视着不断东升的太阳。
……
不知不觉间。
两人就这么坐了半个时辰。
上官明月轻声开口：“我该走了！”
一听这话。
江尘缓慢转过头，目光与上官明月对视在了一起，由于两人是依靠在一起的，他这一转头，两人的鼻尖都快触碰到一起了。
此时。
感受到江尘那扑面而来的男子气息。
上官明月脸颊快速升起一抹红晕，整个人的心跳都加快了不少。
另一边。
看着眼前这张精致的脸庞，江尘内心也不由传出一阵悸动。
忍不住向前靠近了几分。
content_en:
………………
Huh——
After watching for a while.
Shangguan Mingyue slowly closed the "Nine Mysteries of Tianyin", her eyes showing joy.
Subsequently.
Shangguan Mingyue turned his attention to Jiang Chen.
He said softly: "Thank you, I like it very much!"
The words fell.
She put the secret book away solemnly
…
Time flies.
The two chatted while drinking tea.
Unknowingly, a bright light appeared on the horizon.
Look at the sun rising slowly in the east.
Jiang Chen turned his head and looked at Shangguan Mingyue.
"You're in such a hurry to leave, why can't you stay here for a while?"
Shangguan Mingyue slowly shook his head.
He responded: "I can't delay it any longer. They originally wanted me to go back three days ago..."
When it comes to this.
Shangguan Mingyue slowly lowered his head, his voice became a little weaker, and he did not continue speaking.
Jiang Chen nodded slightly, without speaking, but slowly stretched out his arm and put his arm around Shangguan Mingyue's shoulders.
Shangguan Mingyue tilted her body slightly and rested her head on Jiang Chen's shoulder.
at this time.
Neither of them spoke.
Gazing at the rising sun.
…
Unknowingly.
The two of them sat like this for half an hour.
Shangguan Mingyue said softly: "It's time for me to go!"
Upon hearing this.
Jiang Chen slowly turned his head and looked at Shangguan Mingyue. Since the two of them were leaning on each other, when he turned his head, the tips of their noses were almost touching.
at this time.
Feeling Jiang Chen's masculine aura coming towards his face.
A blush quickly rose on Shangguan Mingyue's cheeks, and her heart beat faster.
other side.
Looking at the delicate face in front of him, Jiang Chen couldn't help but feel a flutter in his heart.
Couldn't help but move closer.
